answer: The spiral graph is validated at intake and the canyon frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and saffron anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 18 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 2252 account sybil into a 16 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
